description: Streetcar Ridership is a dataset listed in City of Cincinnati open data portal (data.cincinnati-oh.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Cincinnati. Data Description: This data set contains the daily count of Streetcar ridership throughout the City of Cincinnati. Data Creation: Streetcar Ridership data is created via an Automated Passenger Counter (APC) system installed in the doorways of each streetcar vehicle. APC devices uses infrared lights to approximate the number of entering and exiting riders. Coverage: Cincinnati. The portal files it under the category Efficient Service Delivery. Its tags are streetcar, street, sorta, ridership, rider. The table has 3 columns. Attribution on the portal: Southwest Regional Transit Authority (SORTA). The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cincinnati-oh-gov-portal.
